# GLOps Labs — Full context for AI agents (llms-full.txt)

> Last updated: umbrella B2B studio (v0.1). Canonical home: https://glopslabs.com/
> Summary version: /llms.txt

## 1. What GLOps Labs is

GLOps Labs is a B2B web studio (ES/EN) shipping professional websites in days
for SMBs, professionals and local businesses: based in Venezuela, remote-first
across LatAm. No hourly billing, no infinite scope: closed checklist and fixed
price before kickoff. 50% upfront to start (Payoneer, Facebank or Binance),
balance before deploy to the final domain.

- Home (ES): https://glopslabs.com/
- Home (EN): https://glopslabs.com/en
- Catalog: https://glopslabs.com/servicios (ES) / https://glopslabs.com/en/servicios (EN)

## 2. Standardized catalog (starting prices, USD)

Fast (48-72h): QR menu/catalog $150+, premium link-in-bio $120+, corporate
email + HTML signature $100+, monthly care plan $50+/mo (backups, updates,
uptime, 1h tweaks).
Standard (3-5 days): high-conversion landing $250+, booking system $200+,
migration & rescue $250+, lead funnel + chatbot $400+, speed optimization $200+,
WooCommerce store $350+.
Core (5-7 days): corporate B2B site $500+.

Operating rules: 15-minute intake form, no long meetings (15-min call max).
The clock starts when the client delivers copy, photos and logo; missing
assets are AI-generated at extra cost. Off-checklist requests get re-quoted.

## 3. How ordering works (no backend v0.1)

1. Need: the client describes the project (4-280 chars).
2. Pace: picks Fast / Standard / Core, sees starting price and timeline.
3. Channel: same prefilled text goes to scheduling (cal.com), WhatsApp (wa.me)
or Email (mailto). 50% upfront is required before any work starts.

## 4. Commercial guarantee rules

- Fixed scope: closed checklist + fixed price signed before kickoff.
- Staging with password until final payment; final deploy ships paid.
- Statuses: every catalog service is orderable; retired services are removed,
  never left half-listed.

## 5. Lab status (honest)

- First cases in progress: no fabricated testimonials or metrics. The first
  closed case gets published with real numbers (timeline, closed price, outcome).

## 6. Contact

- Email: ops.glopslabs@gmail.com

- WhatsApp Business: wa.me link (see site env NEXT_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_URL)
- GitHub: https://github.com/GLOps-Labs
